Accept exact metadata and create one bounded operation. A publisher proof
or an import declaration is not permission to open a connection.

Success accepts this finite chunk into the owned transport; it does not
promise remote application processing. An idempotency key permits no retry.

Consume the upload, finish its framing, and return validated response
headers plus an owned body. Header success does not promise a complete body.

None is verified EOF, never a truncated body or a post-header error.
A held chunk keeps its complete capacity; closing the body cannot refund it.

Materialize once per chunk. Later calls return invalid-state. Keep the
chunk until this call has returned, then Drop it to release its capacity.

Materialize once after verified EOF; repeated or premature calls return
invalid-state. Trailers are never used as authorization metadata.
Abort consumes ownership. It cannot undo bytes already sent to a peer.

Owned, immediate HTTP operations. No automatic replay, redirect, upgrade,
application transaction, durable outbox, or rollback is implied.
Every operation and resource retains the original activation deadline.
Dropping an upload/body aborts actual I/O; separately held chunks stay charged.

A cancelled/root-deadline-limited wait never reports requested elapsed
success. The host owns no sleeping worker and borrows no Store at await.

Convert the absolute wall value once at registration into monotonic
waiting; later wall adjustments do not restart the accepted wait.

Invocation-local single-shot or fixed-rate recurrence. Recurrence
coalesces missed ticks; the host never dispatches a callback or builds
a catch-up queue. Zero periods are invalid. Language callback execution
remains bounded by the same task/queue limits and original deadline.

Only one next wait may be live per timer. Returns the number of missed
recurring ticks coalesced into this single readiness result.
Cancels readiness. Pending physical owners stay charged until dropped.

Versioned compiler/runtime support beneath language standard APIs. Tokens
identify only Store-local logical owners; they confer no external authority.
